# Vendored upstream

Source repository: https://github.com/ripunjay-kashyap/audio-sonic-mcp

Upstream snapshot commit:

```text
1cb0e3e36a5ed4cecec95987eb1e419f7b2b34f4
```

The files in this directory were copied for local integration work. The core
Audio Sonic pipeline is intentionally kept separate from the ChatGPT adapter in
`../../audio-sonic-gpt/`.

License: MIT. The upstream LICENSE file is preserved verbatim in this directory.

Local adapter-specific changes should be made outside this vendored directory so
that a future upstream refresh can replace the snapshot cleanly.
